title: Joint safety criterion and least-barrier update for coefficient changes
body:
This scoped proof replaces separate coefficient checks with one exact joint condition. For a nonnegative rank-k subtraction from a retained comparison matrix, the updated matrix has a positive barrier exactly when the small feedback matrix has spectral radius below one. A rational example passes each separate test but fails jointly. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c4becd9c453687043dd96d4e1b996d68ba6398e5/research/coupled-comparison-barrier/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c4becd9c453687043dd96d4e1b996d68ba6398e5/research/coupled-comparison-barrier/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c4becd9c453687043dd96d4e1b996d68ba6398e5/research/coupled-comparison-barrier/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c4becd9c453687043dd96d4e1b996d68ba6398e5/research/coupled-comparison-barrier/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

The initial proof and standalone check are in [Discussion #5297](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5297).

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 375 updates, 8,112 principal-window residual vertices and four singular boundaries. Both print `PASS_COUPLED_BARRIER`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled-comparison-barrier
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39990608016](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39990608016). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Bind a real multi-coefficient update to fixed nonnegative directions and price the complete update. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit Nick Petalas's [PR #5119](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5119) and [least-barrier proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/window-comparison-barrier/README.md), Ali Romman's [Discussion #5263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5263) rank-one update, David Ganz / Dugongue's [PR #3872](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3872), and Jose Manuel's [PR #3851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3851) setup fixture. Woodbury, M-matrix and Perron-Frobenius theory are classical; no general priority claim is made.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
